description: This file defines the BeanFactory class, which manages creation, caching, and retrieval of SugarBean objects within the SuiteCRM application. It handles loading of bean class files, caching of instances, and bean registry management.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating, caching, and managing SugarBean objects, including support for shallow beans and bean registry.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean object by module and id, creating or loading it if necessary, with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getReloadedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a reloaded SugarBean object by module and id, bypassing cache and ensuring fresh data from database.

methods.name: getShallowBean
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shallow version of a bean that doesn't have its relationship fields fully populated; used for relate fields.

methods.name: convertParams
methods.description: Converts input parameters into a standard array format, supporting flexible argument inputs.

methods.name: initBeanRegistry
methods.description: Initializes the internal registry for loaded beans and touched beans for a given module.

methods.name: hasEncodeFlag
methods.description: Extracts the 'encode' flag from parameters or defaults to true.

methods.name: hasDeletedFlag
methods.description: Determines the 'deleted' flag from parameters or defaults to provided value.

methods.name: newBean
methods.description: Creates a new bean instance for a given module.

methods.name: getBeanMeta
methods.description: Provides metadata info for a module's bean, including class, file, and object names.

methods.name: getBeanName
methods.description: Returns the core bean name for a module.

methods.name: getCustomBeanName
methods.description: Returns the custom bean name for a module if available.

methods.name: getBeanClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a module's bean, preferring custom class if available.

methods.name: getObjectName
methods.description: Returns the core object name for a module.

methods.name: getCustomObjectName
methods.description: Returns the custom object name for a module if available.

methods.name: getBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the core file path for a module's bean class.

methods.name: getCustomBeanFile
methods.description: Gets the custom file path for a module's bean class.

methods.name: loadBeanFile
methods.description: Loads the PHP class files for the module's bean and custom bean if they exist.

methods.name: registerBean
methods.description: Registers a bean instance in the factory's cache, managing cache size and order.

methods.name: unregisterBean
methods.description: Removes a bean from the cache by module and id.
